newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's MGTS telecom 1996 pre-tax 511.8 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russia's MGTS telecom 1996 pre-tax 511.8 bln rbls.

text.p: NOTES -- Figures prepared to Russian accounting standards on an accruals basis. Full name of the company is AO Moskovskaya Gorodskaya Telefonnaya Set MGTS.

MGTS major shareholders include state holding company Svyazinvest, which owns 47.67 percent, the Moscow Committee for Science and Technology and Co., with 33.33 percent, Bank of Bermuda (Cayman) Ltd, with 6.03 percent, CS First Boston, with 3.61 percent, and Credit Suisse, with 2.09 percent.
MGTS's plans to publish accounts prepared to international standards by Cooper's & Lybrand, and to issue a $150 million Eurobond in the second half of 1997.

Russian accounting standards differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Russian companies can choose whether to show revenues and spending on a cash or accruals basis. Definitions of profit and assets differ from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
